description:

The stadium has a rich cricketing history, having hosted six first-class matches beginning in 1992, including fixtures between the Uttar Pradesh and Railways cricket teams. It has also hosted several other domestic and non-first-class matches over the years, including a match between the touring Nepal Cricket Team and the Ghaziabad District Cricket Association in 2013.

The stadium also welcomed a Youth Test match between the India Under-19 and England Under-19 cricket teams in 1993, further highlighting its significance in Indian cricket. In addition to cricket, the venue is occasionally used by Ghaziabad FC for association football matches, making it a versatile destination for sports enthusiasts.
